challenge: Execution of a complex curved architectural stadium entrance requiring precise aluminium cladding detailing, adaptable surface coordination, waterproofing continuity, and visually seamless facade integration across multiple curved geometries.
sipanel_solution: SIPANEL developed a customized aluminium cladding and flashing system using coordinated covering solutions specifically optimized for curved architectural geometry and structural integration.
engineering_decision: Engineering teams combined multiple aluminium cladding methods, curved flashing details, and installation sequencing strategies to maintain architectural continuity, structural durability, drainage control, and precise facade alignment.
execution_detail: Execution followed precision shop drawings, curvature alignment checkpoints, controlled installation sequencing, and coordinated sealing workflows to ensure smooth surface transitions and reliable weather protection.
measured_result: Successful delivery of a visually distinctive aluminium-clad stadium entrance with precise architectural finishing, controlled facade integration, and long-term weather-resistant performance.
primary_message: Precision-engineered aluminium cladding systems designed for complex curved architectural sports structures.

metrics.execution_focus: Curved geometry precision and waterproof facade integration
